## Summary

<!-- What changed and why, in 1-3 sentences. Reference issues with "Closes #123" to auto-close on merge. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `refactor` — code change without functional change
- [ ] `docs` — documentation
- [ ] `build` / `ci` / `chore` — deps, CI, tooling
- [ ] Breaking change (mark title with `!` after type, e.g. `feat!:`)

<!-- What you tested. Include both automated (CI) and any manual verification. -->

- [ ] CI is green
- [ ] Types pass
- [ ] Docs updated where relevant
